title: 第9章
content_zh: 第九章 砸了交警队新的一周，军医需要票票，冰天雪地三百六十度求票票！求收藏！萧凛一愣，单据上不是说今天过来缴纳罚款取车吗？如果只是这样，萧凛也只能自认倒霉，自己确实违反了交通规则，但是车子被拖吊已经是从重处罚了，而且罚款高达两千块，这个萧凛都认了，但是现在自己来了，却又被告知三天后才能取车，欺负人可以，但是不能这么的欺负人。“为什么？”萧凛问道，语气中带了一点生气的意味在里面，泥人还有土性呢。“你觉得你违反交通规则还有理了？”那男警员一听萧凛这话，顿时更加不客气了，不就是开一辆QQ车嘛，也就两三万块钱，跟自己的马自达根本没得比，语气还这么的不善。“我知道我违反了交通规则，但是绝对不会严重到扣车三天的地步，甚至这两千的罚款都达不到！”萧凛脸色一沉，那男警员眼中流露出来的不屑让萧凛更加火大。“不严重？下班的高峰时期专门掉转车头停在人行道上，眼中扰**通次序，只是扣你三天的车子，已经是很厚道了，信不信我再把你的驾驶证吊销？”男警员义正言辞的说道。“有本事你就扣吧！”萧凛不屑的看了一眼那男警员，淡淡的说道：“记住你刚才所说的话，如果你有这个本事，你尽管扣！”男警员也不知道吃了什么药，冷笑一声，道：“放心，我会如你所愿的，你这辆车子就准备待在城南交警队养老吧！”话不投机半句多，萧凛也不想多说废话了，还好刚才叫了华清逸过来，否则今天这面子可是载定了。看到萧凛气冲冲的出去，那女警员看了看男警员，淡淡的笑道：“谭哥，你这唱的到底是哪一出啊！”女警员虽然参加工作不到两年，却也看得出来，眼前这谭哥绝对是专门为难那个小帅哥的，早上上班的时候，就听他说了，只要碰见这辆QQ车的车主，就叫他三天后来，而这辆车子可是一中队的吴霜通知拖吊。“没办法，吴队长交代下来的事情，我敢不办吗？”那名叫谭哥的警员倒是没有瞒着女警员，“你就不怕对方有什么后手？”女警员问道。“后手？开一辆破QQ的主，能有什么后手，即使有，我会怕吗？”谭哥显然认为一辆破QQ的车主，普通上班族的穿着，不会有什么背景，随便就能捏死他了，谭哥参加工作也有五六年了，都成了老油条。况且能够进入交警队事故科工作的，又有哪个没有一点小背景？对付一个开辆两三万QQ车的车主，有必要怕吗？更何况这件事情是心目中的女神所交代的，就算碰了硬钉子又如何。萧凛什么时候受过这样的气？虽然萧凛一直秉持着低调的态度，奈何别人就不想让他低调，本来萧凛叫华清逸过来，只是还他的车子，这下子正好，以华清逸的身世背景，还怕搞不定这个小小的交警？交警中队的大门口，一辆红色的美洲豹停了下来，随着华清逸下车的是一个穿着十分妖艳的女子，脸上擦了厚厚的粉底，猩红的双唇，一件火红色的吊带短裙，雪白修长的大腿性感无比，别有一番致命的诱惑。华清逸依旧是白色的休闲套装，充满着清新飘逸的气质，跟那个妖艳的女子站在一起，却不是很搭，不过华清逸就是喜欢妖艳的女子，个人口味是没办法改变的。华清逸一下子，便看到萧凛冷着脸站在交警中队的内院，华清逸对着那女子说了几句话，女子似乎有点不情愿，不过却拗不过华清逸，看了一眼不远处的萧凛，上车便直接走了。“哥，怎么了，车子呢？”华清逸看到萧凛脸色不善，心中倒是有点忐忑不安，自己这哥哥的性格华清逸最为清楚不过，虽然平时看似善良无害，但要是发起飙来，天王老子都怕。“叫我三天后再来拿！”萧凛只是淡淡的说了一句。“我靠，欺负人欺负到我们头上了？城南交警中队？”华清逸只是说了一声，便直接掏出手机，拨通了手机，然后只是说了一句：“今天我要把城南交警中队的地盘给砸了！”萧凛倒是吓了一跳，苦笑的向华清逸说道：“小子，你还是那样的火爆脾气，用不着这么大的动静，只要把车子拿出来就行了！”萧凛可不是那种得理不饶人的性格，也不想弄这么大的动静出来。“从来只有我们欺负人的份，在燕京还有人敢欺负咱们，真是活腻了！”华清逸不依不挠，向交警中队的大楼走过去。萧凛知道要不拦着华清逸的话，他还真做得出直接砸了这里，连忙上前冷声道：“小子，是不是连哥的话都不听了？”萧凛这么一发话，华清逸火气虽然还在，却也停下了脚步，看向萧凛道：“哥，那你要怎样？我随你！”对于萧凛，华清逸还真不敢忤他的逆。“其实我只是气刚才事故科的那个小警员说的话，说要扣我的驾驶证，还说要我的车子在交警队养老！”萧凛慢悠悠的说道：“我的要求没你那么高，拿出车子，把那小子踢出交警队就行了！”“好吧，你是哥，你说了算了！”华清逸听到萧凛这么说了，也就不再坚持砸了交警队：“那现在我们就去他们队长的办公室，我倒要看看敢扣我哥驾驶证的小交警到底什么来头，底气这么大！”两人步入交警中队的大厅，华清逸突然想起昨晚上萧凛说过的，扣留萧凛车子的是一名美女，而现在萧凛的车子要扣留三天，显然不是同一个所为，侧过身向萧凛问道：“对了，哥，那拖吊你车子的那个女警怎么处理？”之前萧凛却是没有想过这样的问题，对方拖吊自己的车子虽然有点无理取闹在里面，但是严格上来说，程序上根本就没有什么问题，萧凛想了想，笑笑道：“算了，昨晚我确实违反交通规则了，这点我认！”“哦，我听哥的！”华清逸倒是想见见这位女交警了，能够让哥哥萧凛起了惜花之意，应该差不到哪里去。
content_en: Chapter 9: The traffic police team was smashed. In the new week, the military doctors need votes. They go 360 degrees in the ice and snow to ask for votes! Please collect it! Xiao Lin was stunned. Didn't the receipt say that he came to pay the fine and pick up the car today? If this was the case, Xiao Lin could only admit that he was unlucky. He had indeed violated traffic rules, but his car was towed, which was already a severe penalty, and the fine was as high as 2,000 yuan. Xiao Lin recognized this, but now that he came, he was told that he could only pick up the car after three days. Bullying is okay, but you can't bully people like this. "Why?" Xiao Lin asked, with a bit of anger in his tone. The clay figurine still has earthy nature. "Do you think it's okay for you to violate traffic rules?" When the male police officer heard Xiao Lin's words, he became even more rude. He just drove a QQ car, which cost only 20,000 to 30,000 yuan. It was not comparable to his own Mazda, and his tone was so unkind. "I know I violated the traffic rules, but it will never be serious enough to detain the car for three days, or even a fine of two thousand!" Xiao Lin's face darkened, and the disdain in the male police officer's eyes made Xiao Lin even more angry. "It's not serious? You turned around and parked your car on the sidewalk during the rush hour after get off work. You disturbed the traffic order in your eyes. It's very kind to just detain your car for three days. Do you believe that I will revoke your driver's license again?" the male police officer said righteously. "If you have the ability, just deduct it!" Xiao Lin glanced at the male police officer with disdain and said lightly: "Remember what you just said, if you have the ability, just deduct it!" The male police officer didn't know what kind of medicine he had taken, and sneered and said: "Don't worry, I will do as you wish. Your car will stay at the traffic police station in the south of the city for retirement!" Xiao Lin didn't want to talk nonsense anymore. Fortunately, he called Hua Qingyi just now, otherwise his face would have been sealed today. Seeing Xiao Lin storming out, the female police officer looked at the male police officer and said with a faint smile: "Brother Tan, which song are you singing about?" Although the female police officer had been on the job for less than two years, she could tell that Brother Tan in front of her was definitely trying to make things difficult for that handsome boy. When she went to work in the morning, she heard him say that whenever she met the owner of this QQ car, she would ask him to come back in three days, and this car was towed by Wu Shuang of the No. 1 Squadron. "I can't help it. Do I dare not do what Captain Wu told me?" The police officer named Tan Ge did not hide anything from the female police officer. "Aren't you afraid of what the other party might do?" the female police officer asked. "Backhand? What kind of backhand can the owner of a broken QQ have? Even if there is one, would I be afraid?" Brother Tan obviously thinks that the owner of a broken QQ, dressed like an ordinary office worker, has no background, can kill him casually. Brother Tan has been working for five or six years, and he has become a veteran. Besides, who can work in the accident department of the traffic police team without a little background? Do you need to be afraid of a car owner who drives a QQ car worth RMB 20,000 to RMB 30,000? What's more, this matter was told by the goddess in my heart, so what if it hits a hard nail. When had Xiao Lin ever been so angry? Although Xiao Lin has always maintained a low-key attitude, others don't want him to keep a low profile. Originally, Xiao Lin asked Hua Qingyi to come over and just return his car. Now it was just right. With Hua Qingyi's background, were he afraid that he would not be able to deal with this little traffic policeman? At the gate of the traffic police squadron, a red Jaguar stopped. Following Hua Qingyi, a woman dressed very coquettishly got out of the car. She had thick foundation on her face, scarlet lips, a fiery red suspender skirt, and her snow-white slender thighs were extremely sexy, and she had a fatal temptation. Hua Qingyi is still wearing a white casual suit, full of fresh and elegant temperament. Standing next to that coquettish woman, it doesn't match well. However, Hua Qingyi likes coquettish women, and his personal taste cannot be changed. Hua Qingyi suddenly saw Xiao Lin standing in the inner courtyard of the traffic police squadron with a cold face. Hua Qingyi said a few words to the woman. The woman seemed a little reluctant, but she couldn't resist Hua Qingyi. She glanced at Xiao Lin not far away, got in the car and left directly. "Brother, what's wrong, where's the car?" Hua Qingyi felt a little uneasy when he saw Xiao Lin's unkind expression. Hua Qingyi knew the character of his brother best. Although he seemed kind and harmless at ordinary times, if he got angry, even the king of heaven would be afraid of him. "Ask me to pick it up again in three days!" Xiao Lin just said lightly. "Damn it, are the bullies bullying us? Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron?" Hua Qingyi just said, took out his mobile phone, dialed the phone, and then just said: "Today I will destroy the territory of Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron!" Xiao Lin, on the other hand, said Startled, he said to Hua Qingyi with a wry smile: "Boy, you still have such a hot temper. You don't need to make such a big noise, just take out the car!" Xiao Lin is not the kind of person who is unreasonable and does not want to make such a big noise. "We have always been the only ones who bully others. There are still people in Yanjing who dare to bully us. I'm really tired of living!" Hua Qingyi persisted and walked towards the building of the traffic police squadron. Xiao Lin knew that if he didn't stop Hua Qingyi, he would have smashed the place. He quickly stepped forward and said coldly: "Boy, don't you even listen to my brother's words?" After Xiao Lin said this, although Hua Qingyi was still angry, he stopped and looked at Xiao Lin and said: "Brother, what do you want? I'll let you!" Regarding Xiao Lin, Hua Qingyi really didn't dare to disobey him. "Actually, I'm just angry about what the young police officer from the accident department said just now. He said that he would take away my driver's license and that my car would be retired in the traffic police team!" Xiao Lin said slowly: "My requirements are not as high as yours. Just take out the car and kick that kid out of the traffic police team!" "Okay, you are.
